posts.text:
Steel frames can cost less on the day. Then the years start.

Steel rusts. It needs repainting. The putty cracks and the pane sits loose. Most old steel carries single glazing, so the room is cold in June and loud in October.

Aluminium does not rust and does not need paint. It carries modern glass: safety, laminated, low-e or double glazed. Over the twenty to thirty years a window lasts, it costs less and does more. That is why the trade moved to it.

WhatsApp us on 082 892 3957 for a free estimate.

posts.text:
What replacing steel windows with aluminium actually involves. Seven steps.

1. Inspect every opening.
2. Measure the actual opening, not the old frame.
3. Agree the window schedule: which windows, which glass, which colour.
4. Manufacture every frame before a single steel one comes out.
5. Remove the old steel carefully, one opening at a time.
6. Fit, level, fix and seal the new frame.
7. Make good, and sign off with you.

A full home of eight to twelve windows is usually three to five working days on site once the frames are made. We give you the timeline at the quote. WhatsApp us on 082 892 3957 for a free estimate.

posts.text:
"Is glass safe?" It is when it is the right glass in the right place.

South Africa's building rules, SANS 10400-N, say where safety glass is required: in any door, in panels close to a door, in low glazing near the floor, and in shower doors and screens. Toughened glass is the usual answer. If it ever breaks, it crumbles into small blunt granules instead of shards.

We fit to the standard, and safety glazing is marked so the marking stays visible after installation. The work is certified through the family glazing company that carries SAGGA and AAAMSA accreditation.

The question we get most about patio doors: sliding or stacking?

Sliding doors have panels that move behind each other on a track. About half the total width opens. Fewer moving parts, and a good fit for most openings.

Stacking doors fold and stack to one side. The whole opening clears, so the inside and the braai area become one room. That is what you see here, half open on a commercial building.

Both are made to the opening. We will tell you which suits yours. WhatsApp us on 082 892 3957 for a free estimate.
